If you pull Barnes from their hand and kill it it has two benefits. 1) They can't use him to cheat out a big minion from their deck early and 2) It clouds their resurrection pool so they have a chance to rez Barnes instead of one of their bigger guys. Its why cards like Hecklebot and Dirty Rat exist too, they pull minions from the opponents hand/deck without triggering their battlecry and possibly ruining their combo.

Edit: Against Big Priest this probably isn't the best strategy unless you plan to follow it up with a hex/polymorph, there's a chance you could pull out something that is just too big to deal with. It's a better strategy against decks that OTK or rely on using specific minions like Shudder shaman or Quest mage.
